description: List the X (Twitter) ad accounts this profile can act on, with the PERMISSION LEVEL held on each so you can tell an admin grant from a read-only one before attempting a write. X grants API access PER AD ACCOUNT, not per app: the customer adds Hermoso’s X user to their ad account at business.x.com -> Account access, and it appears here. Read-only, free.
name: list_x_ads_accounts
title: List X ad accounts
